in_hebrew.name: Alderson
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Old, powerful ruler
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alderson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English 'aeld' meaning 'old' and 'sige' meaning 'victory' or 'ruler'. This name was borne by several early saints and noblemen in Europe.

in_greek.name: Alderson
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Old, powerful ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Alderson είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English 'aeld' meaning 'old' and 'sige' meaning 'victory' or 'ruler'. This name was borne by several early saints and noblemen in Europe.

in_latin.name: Alderson
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Old, powerful ruler
in_latin.long_meaning: Alderson est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English 'aeld' meaning 'old' and 'sige' meaning 'victory' or 'ruler'. This name was borne by several early saints and noblemen in Europe.
